title: Ollama
descript: Ollama runs large language models locally and exposes a simple HTTP API plus an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container and stores downloaded models in the application data folder.
important: Pull a model first, for example "docker exec ollamadocker ollama pull qwen2.5:3b". The API listens on port 11434 (/api, OpenAI-compatible /v1). Models live in /Volume1/DockerAppData/ollamadocker/ and survive restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000. CPU inference works out of the box; GPU use needs extra device passthrough. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: A self-hosted habit tracking app without "Goals"

zh-cn.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
